title: Default network when building images
body:
### Issue Description

Per https://docs.podman.io/en/v5.8.3/markdown/podman-build.1.html#network-mode-net, `private` should be used by default, but that doesn't seem to be the case.

This only happens in 5.x and works as expected in 6.0.2. But it seems like a security issue to me, so perhaps the fix should be backported to 5.x assuming that it is still supported.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

```
$ cat Dockerfile
FROM docker.io/nicolaka/netshoot:v0.16

RUN ip -4 -brief address show
RUN nc -zv 127.0.0.1 8000
```

```
$ nc -l 127.0.0.1 8000 & podman build --no-cache .
[1] 2793112
STEP 1/3: FROM docker.io/nicolaka/netshoot:v0.16
STEP 2/3: RUN ip -4 -brief address show
lo               UNKNOWN        127.0.0.1/8
wlp0s20f3        UP             172.24.192.169/22
virbr1           DOWN           192.168.39.1/24
virbr0           DOWN           192.168.122.1/24
docker0          DOWN           172.17.0.1/16
--> e06de85b33ce
STEP 3/3: RUN nc -zv 127.0.0.1 8000
Connection to 127.0.0.1 8000 port [tcp/*] succeeded!
COMMIT
--> 536947d9d336
536947d9d336e8e21c41bbeb21a50525a5a0aab036b83eb8fdd0b247ebcac51a
[1]+  Done                       nc -l 127.0.0.1 8000
```

```
$ nc -l 127.0.0.1 8000 & podman build --no-cache --network=private .
[1] 2793468
STEP 1/3: FROM docker.io/nicolaka/netshoot:v0.16
STEP 2/3: RUN ip -4 -brief address show
lo               UNKNOWN        127.0.0.1/8
wlp0s20f3        UNKNOWN        172.24.192.169/22
--> efa43659c14f
STEP 3/3: RUN nc -zv 127.0.0.1 8000
nc: connect to 127.0.0.1 port 8000 (tcp) failed: Connection refused
Error: building at STEP "RUN nc -zv 127.0.0.1 8000": while running runtime: exit status 1
```

### Describe the results you received

`host` network appears to be used if `--network` is not specified when building an image.

### Describe the results you expected

`private` network should be used by default.
